background.text: The Annunciation is a painting by the Italian Renaissance artist Leonardo da Vinci, dated to c. 1472, 1476. Leonardo's earliest extant major work, it was completed in Florence while he was an apprentice in the studio of Andrea del Verrocchio. The painting was made using oil and tempera on a large poplar panel and depicts the Annunciation, a popular biblical subject in 15th-century Florence. Since 1867 it has been housed in the Uffizi in Florence, the city where it was created. Though the work has been criticized for inaccuracies in its composition, it is among the best-known portrayals of the Annunciation in Christian art.
L'Annunciazione è un dipinto a olio e tempera su tavola, attribuito a Leonardo da Vinci, databile tra il 1472 e il 1475 circa e conservato nella Galleria degli Uffizi di Firenze.

L'Annonciation est un tableau de l'atelier de Verrocchio, attribué à Léonard de Vinci et exposé à la galerie des Offices de Florence. Il représente l’ange Gabriel saluant la Vierge Marie et l'interrompant dans sa lecture de la Bible pour lui annoncer qu’elle est destinée à donner naissance au fils de Dieu. C'est une œuvre de jeunesse de Léonard de Vinci que l'on date des années 1472-1475.
